The silver shaft must occupy most of the overall length. A small simple charcoal circular pivot at the top, a tiny dark collar, a compact matte charcoal headshell at the bottom. Soft restrained 2.5D product rendering, subtle metal highlights and depth, clean smooth silhouette. No industrial machinery, screws, oversized rectangular pivot block, big counterweight or thick pipe.
